# Dependencies are generated by helper.py
set(REQUIRES_V4 app_update bootloader_support console esp32 esp_adc_cal esp_eth esp_hid esp_http_client esp_http_server esp_lcd fatfs json mdns nvs_flash sdmmc spi_flash spiffs tinyusb touch_element u8g2 usb wear_levelling)

set(REQUIRES_V5 app_update bootloader_support console esp-tls esp_adc esp_eth esp_hid esp_http_client esp_https_server esp_lcd esp_partition esp_psram esp_vfs_console fatfs http_parser json mqtt nvs_flash sdmmc spi_flash spiffs touch_element u8g2 usb wear_levelling wpa_supplicant)

if(IDF_VERSION_MAJOR LESS 5)
    set(REQUIRES ${REQUIRES_V4})
else()
    set(REQUIRES ${REQUIRES_V5})
endif()
idf_component_register(SRC_DIRS "." INCLUDE_DIRS "include" REQUIRES ${REQUIRES})
